subject: Promo code surge request — mini-summit attendee trial pool
messages:
From: BrightConf Events <events@brightconf.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 29 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: surge of attendee trials for Mini Summit (Nov 7)

Hi Hannah,

Hope you’re doing well — we’re finalizing attendee communications for the Data Practitioners Mini-Summit on Nov 7 and had two asks:  

1) Can Redwood provide an additional 500 promotional trial codes (7-day trial) for registrants who sign up on the day-of? The current pool you provided is close to depletion.
2) If possible, extend the expiry window so attendees can redeem through Dec 31 (instead of the standard 30 days). That helps late adopters who want to try before year-end.

Attached is the attendee_list.csv with rough counts per session. We need confirmation by EOD Monday (Nov 1) so we can populate the event emails and QR codes.

If there are limits, let us know what you can support and we’ll prioritize sessions.

Thanks — excited to partner on this.

— Olivia (on behalf of BrightConf Events)
Olivia Park
Program Lead, BrightConf
[attachment: attendee_list.csv (csv)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 30 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: surge of attendee trials for Mini Summit (Nov 7)

Folks — forwarding a last-minute surge request from BrightConf. Key points: they want +500 7-day trials and an expiry extension to Dec 31. Deadline EOD Monday.

Quick asks for you all:
- Marissa: can we approve a partial pool from marketing promo budget (how many can you commit this week)?
- Ben: is there available reserved pool / prepaid capacity we can tap without impacting other demos (need throughput for devs using trials)?
- Connor: ops note — extending expiry will change billing buckets and reporting. If approved, we should apply a metadata flag so it's traceable.

I attached the event proposal (proposal-mini-summit.pdf) they shared. If we can’t do 500, propose a split (e.g., 350 immediate + a second tranche next week).

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[attachment: proposal-mini-summit.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 30 Oct 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: surge of attendee trials for Mini Summit (Nov 7)

Hannah —

I can commit up to 350 promo/trial vouchers from the marketing event pool this week. Recommendation:
- 300 x 14-day trial codes (slightly longer gives better airtime)
- 50 x 30-day redemption-extension codes for VIPs/speakers

That preserves runway for the rest of November. If Olivia needs 500 now, we can do an additional 150 next week pending budget reconciliation.

Ben — can you confirm we have the capacity to issue 350 without impacting demo throughput? If not, we’ll stagger distribution.

Marissa
Director, Demand Gen, Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: BrightConf Events <events@brightconf.com>, Ava Gardner <ava@datafoundry.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 31 Oct 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: surge of attendee trials for Mini Summit (Nov 7)

Hi Olivia / Ava —

Good news: Redwood can support a partial surge for the Mini-Summit. Approved items:
- 300 promotional codes (14-day trials) to distribute on Nov 7
- 50 extended-redeem vouchers (30-day) reserved for speakers and VIP attendees

We’re unable to fulfill the full 500 immediately due to other ongoing commitments, but can release an additional 150 codes in a follow-up tranche next Wednesday (Nov 3) if needed. Please confirm whether you want us to split the release (300 now + 150 next week + 50 VIP) or reallocate differently.

Operational details:
- Codes will be unique single-use tokens and tagged with event:BRIGHTCONF-MINI-11-07 in our reporting.
- Extended-redeem vouchers will have metadata flag "event_vip_ext" so your team and ours can track redemptions separately.
- We’ll send a DocuSign addendum for the credit/usage terms (short form) and a sample of 10 promo codes for your QA.

Related HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/98765 (RF-2026-0921-BR).

Attachments: promo_codes_sample.txt (10 codes for QA).

If that works, we’ll generate the full pool and share a delivery spreadsheet with redemption windows.

Thanks — looking forward to the event.

— Hannah Schmitt
Head of Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
[attachment: promo_codes_sample.txt]
